sources.snippet: AI News Anchor is a fully autonomous system that fetches real-time news based on a user-given topic, generates human-like anchor scripts, converts them to realistic voiceovers, and produces complete news videos featuring a talking AI avatar with relevant B-roll visuals. This project showcases the power of generative AI in media automation and the future of AI-driven journalism.
